IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: NATIONAL PHILANTHROPIC TRUST IS A PUBLIC CHARITY DEDICATED TO INCREASING PHILANTHROPY IN SOCIETY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: NATIONAL PHILANTHROPIC TRUST ("NPT") IS A PUBLIC CHARITY DEDICATED TO INCREASING PHILANTHROPY IN SOCIETY BY PROVIDING PHILANTHROPIC EXPERTISE TO DONORS, FOUNDATIONS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS, ENABLING THEM TO REALIZE THEIR PHILANTHROPIC ASPIRATIONS (SEE SCHEDULE O).
IRS990.Desc: NPT GRANTED $6.42 BILLION TO QUALIFIED CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS IN THE U.S. AND 67 OTHER COUNTRIES ON BEHALF OF ITS DONORS IN THE TAX YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025. NPT DONORS RECOMMENDED MORE THAN 161,000 GRANTS FROM THEIR DAFS TO OVER 48,000 CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS DURING THE TAX YEAR. ADDITIONALLY, NPT CONTINUED ENHANCING DONOR ONLINE EXPERIENCES, PHILANTHROPIC SERVICE OFFERINGS, INVESTMENT OPTIONS, AND GRANTMAKING CAPABILITIES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NATIONAL PHILANTHROPIC TRUST AND AFFILIATES (ORGANIZATIONS") ARE GENERALLY EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAXES UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE CODE. IN ADDITION, THE ORGANIZATIONS QUALIFY FOR CHARITABLE CONTRIBUTION DEDUCTIONS AND HAVE BEEN CLASSIFIED AS ORGANIZATIONS THAT ARE NOT PRIVATE FOUNDATIONS. THE ORGANIZATIONS ARE SUBJECT TO INCOME TAXES ON NET INCOME THAT IS DERIVED FROM A TRADE OR BUSINESS, REGULARLY CARRIED ON, AND NOT IN FURTHERANCE OF THE PURPOSES FOR WHICH IT WAS GRANTED EXEMPTION. THE ORGANIZATIONS' AGGREGATE OBLIGATION FOR UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME TAX FOR THE YEARS ENDED JUNE 30, 2025 AND 2024, WAS APPROXIMATELY $778,000 AND $436,000, RESPECTIVELY. THE ORGANIZATIONS FILE U.S., UK AND STATE INCOME TAX RETURNS IN JURISDICTIONS, AS APPLICABLE, TO REPORT SUCH INCOME. THE ORGANIZATIONS FOLLOW THE ACCOUNTING GUIDANCE ON ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES (FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING STANDARDS BOARD (FASB) ASC TOPIC 740-10), WHICH ADDRESSES THE DETERMINATION OF WHETHER TAX BENEFITS CLAIMED OR EXPECTED TO BE CLAIMED ON A TAX RETURN SHOULD BE RECORDED ON THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. UNDER THIS GUIDANCE, THE ORGANIZATIONS MAY RECOGNIZE THE TAX BENEFIT FROM AN UNCERTAIN TAX POSITION ONLY IF IT IS MORE LIKELY THAN NOT THAT THE TAX POSITION WILL BE SUSTAINED ON EXAMINATION BY A TAX AUTHORITY. THE TAX BENEFITS RECOGNIZED IN THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FROM SUCH A POSITION ARE MEASURED BASED ON THE LARGEST BENEFIT THAT HAS A GREATER THAN 50% LIKELIHOOD OF BEING REALIZED UPON ULTIMATE SETTLEMENT. THE GUIDANCE ON ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES ALSO ADDRESSES DERECOGNITION, CLASSIFICATION, INTEREST AND PENALTIES ON INCOME TAXES, AND ACCOUNTING IN INTERIM PERIODS. MANAGEMENT EVALUATED THE ORGANIZATIONS' TAX POSITIONS AND CONCLUDED THAT THE ORGANIZATIONS HAVE TAKEN NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT REQUIRE ADJUSTMENT TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS TO COMPLY WITH THE PROVISIONS OF THIS GUIDANCE. NO MATERIAL ACCRUAL FOR INTEREST AND PENALTIES WAS DEEMED NECESSARY FOR THE YEARS ENDED JUNE 30, 2025 AND 2024. THE ORGANIZATIONS FILE INFORMATIONAL TAX RETURNS IN U.S. AND UK JURISDICTIONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF TREASURY RECOGNIZES TWO METHODS OF INTERNATIONAL GRANTMAKING: EQUIVALENCY DETERMINATION AND EXPENDITURE RESPONSIBILITY. NPT UTILIZES BOTH METHODS TO FACILITATE ITS INTERNATIONAL GRANTMAKING AS APPROPRIATE. ALL INTERNATIONAL GRANTS ARE SUBMITTED TO EITHER THE DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE OF NPT'S BOARD OF TRUSTEES OR STAFF DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL PRIOR TO DISBURSEMENT OF GRANT FUNDS. EQUIVALENCY DETERMINATION (ED) IS A PROCESS TO ASSESS WHETHER A POTENTIAL NON-U.S. GRANTEE ORGANIZATION IS THE EQUIVALENT OF A U.S. PUBLIC CHARITY. NPT ENGAGES THIRD PARTY PROVIDERS TO ASSESS THE RESPECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND ISSUE AN ED OPINION FOR NPT'S ED GRANTS. NPT MAINTAINS MEMBERSHIP WITH A THIRD PARTY PROVIDER OF EDS THAT ASSESSES THE RESPECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND ISSUES AN ED OPINION FOR NPT'S ED GRANTS. ADDITIONALLY, NPT ENGAGES OUTSIDE LEGAL COUNSEL FOR ED OPINIONS, AS NEEDED. THE GRANT IS THEN SUBMITTED TO EITHER THE DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE OF NPT'S BOARD OF TRUSTEES OR STAFF DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL PRIOR TO DISBURSEMENT OF GRANT FUNDS. EXPENDITURE RESPONSIBILITY (ER) MEANS THAT NPT USES REASONABLE EFFORTS AND ADEQUATE PROCEDURES TO ENSURE THAT A GRANT IS SPENT ONLY FOR THE CHARITABLE PURPOSE FOR WHICH IT IS MADE AND OBTAINS FULL AND COMPLETE REPORTS FROM THE GRANTEE ORGANIZATION ON HOW THE FUNDS ARE SPENT. FOR ER GRANTS, NPT REQUIRES THAT ITS OVERSEAS GRANT RECIPIENTS COMPLETE A PRE-GRANT SCREENING PROCESS, WHICH BEGINS WITH A QUESTIONNAIRE REQUESTING ORGANIZATIONAL INFORMATION SUCH AS MISSION, FINANCIALS AND BOARD COMPOSITION. THIS QUESTIONNAIRE ALSO REQUIRES SPECIFIC DETAILS REGARDING THE PLANNED USE OF GRANT FUNDS, INCLUDING A PROPOSED BUDGET, TO ENSURE THAT THE FUNDS ARE INTENDED FOR CHARITABLE PURPOSES. NPT ALSO REVIEWS THIS DOCUMENT TO CONFIRM THAT "SPECIFICALLY DESIGNATED NATIONALS" ("SDNS") ARE NOT PRINCIPALS OF, BOARD MEMBERS OF OR SUBSTANTIAL CONTRIBUTORS TO THE RECIPIENT ORGANIZATION. THE OFFICE OF FOREIGN ASSETS CONTROL OF THE U.S. TREASURY DESIGNATES SDNS AS INDIVIDUALS OR COMPANIES OWNED OR CONTROLLED BY, OR ACTING FOR OR ON BEHALF OF, COUNTRIES THAT ARE ECONOMICALLY SANCTIONED FOR SUCH ACTIVITIES AS TERRORISM OR NARCOTICS TRAFFICKING. IF ALL COMPONENTS OF THE SCREENING PROCESS MEET NPT'S STANDARDS, THE GRANT IS SUBMITTED TO EITHER THE DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE OF NPT'S BOARD OF TRUSTEES OR STAFF DISTRIBUTION COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL. IF APPROVED, THE RECIPIENT MUST AGREE IN WRITING TO PROVIDE A FINANCIAL AND NARRATIVE REPORT ON THE USE OF THE GRANT FUNDS WITHIN 12 MONTHS OF THE GRANT AWARD. IF THE GRANT FUNDS HAVE NOT BEEN FULLY EXPENDED WITHIN 12 MONTHS, NPT WILL REINITIATE AND REPEAT THE ENTIRE ER PROCESS; AND THE PROCESS WILL BE REPEATED EVERY 12 MONTHS UNTIL THE GRANT FUNDS HAVE BEEN FULLY EXPENDED. IF THE RECIPIENT FAILS TO SUBMIT THE REPORT, THAT ORGANIZATION BECOMES INELIGIBLE TO RECEIVE FUTURE GRANTS FROM NPT. A REPORT OF NPT'S ER GRANTS ISSUED DURING THE FISCAL YEAR AND FOR WHICH REPORTING IS PENDING IS ATTACHED HERETO.
